extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. Created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. Used for training Arabic-Nougat OCR models.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The arabic-img2md dataset was generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text, resulting in 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website (https://www.hindawi.org/).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content was scraped from Hindawi, converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML-to-PDF conversion followed by Markdown text extraction to produce paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (Markdown representations) were generated automatically by extracting Markdown text from HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website and pairing them with rendered book page images.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: HTML scraping and conversion pipeline (Hindawi website HTML to PDF to Markdown).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and datasets are open-sourced and available on Hugging Face and GitHub (https://github.com/MohamedAliRashad/arabic-nougat).
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Contributes to digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic and promotes the broader field of document parsing for non-Latin scripts.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. Expanding the dataset to include diverse genres and styles is critical for improving model robustness.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset biases from Hindawi-only content limit generalization to other Arabic text domains (scientific, religious, historical). Models trained on this data exhibit hallucination issues (in arabic-small-nougat) and repetition issues in larger models. Performance on multilingual or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested, and highly irregular or multi-modal layouts (dense tables, charts, images) may require additional preprocessing.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR models (arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat). A test set of 160 random, unseen Arabic book pages was used for evaluation. Recommended for Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction tasks.
